**What type of PR is this?**

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

We are lacking tests that exercise a full scheduler setup, all the way from config files and command line flags to what plugins end up instantiated. 

This PR does two things:
1. split `runCommand` function in  `cmd/kube-scheduler/app/server.go` into two parts, `setupCommand` and `Run`
2. add test for `setupCommand` to get a full scheduler setup from config files and command line flags, and check the instantiated plugins

issue_context.title: Scheduler: Add tests for server.go for close-to-full E2E setup
issue_context.body:
We are lacking tests that exercise a full scheduler setup, all the way from config files and command line flags to what plugins end up instantiated.

The best candidate for this is `cmd/kube-scheduler/app/server.go`, but this needs tweaking. Basically, we need to split `runCommand` in two functions: `setupCommand` and the already existing  `Run` (which already has a test). Maybe we can have the test in `cmd/kube-scheduler/app/testing` as well.

Configuration can be written to files just like we do in `cmd/kube-scheduler/app/options/options_test.go` and args can be passed as parameters.

/sig scheduling
/help
/kind cleanup

review_comments: Sorry for the back-and-forth. I think we can have this directly in `runCommand` instead, right before calling Run. Otherwise, there is no other reason to pass both `cc` and `opts` to run. And we don't need to WriteConfigTo in unit tests or serving tests.

I think we need to reach to the OWNERS of the users of this library (`/pkg/integration/serving`) to learn what are their expectations. Perhaps we can change this to be much closer to `runCommand`. Otherwise, anything that is not common, should go outside of `Setup`.
That is true. But at least we don't need to worry about it when testing Setup. If this is what other binaries are doing for the serving test, that's great.
